summary: Clock source and timezone: read the device local wall clock as a local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm string and compare it with slot times as strings, with no timezone conversion
Overlapping slots: seed slots do not overlap, and if several slots ever contain the current time only the first in groupBySlot order is current
Track filter interaction: the current slot is computed from the rendered slots, so a slot hidden by the track filter means nothing is highlighted and no hint is shown
Rule ownership: core decides the current slot from an argument, ui renders it from a prop, agenda alone reads the clock through an adapter and hook
Now label placement: render the English text Now as a sibling right after the h2, so the heading accessible name stays the time range
aria-current target: the ticket example is taken literally, with aria-current=time on the slot li and the attribute absent on every other slot
Highlight styling: use a slot class in ScheduleList.module.css with existing tokens only, with no new tokens and no new exported component

Timer behaviour: evaluate on first render and then on a plain 30 second interval cleared on unmount, accepting up to 30 seconds of lag at slot boundaries, with no minute alignment or visibility handling
